name: Farnum Park LLC
skip_reason: Workforce park, stated by the operator. farnumpark.com says in its own words: 'If you are from out of state and are coming to North Central WV for work, then Farnum Park is for you', and describes utilities as 'included in rent' rather than in a nightly rate - a monthly-tenancy framing for Marcellus gas-field workers around Clarksburg. The 3-night minimum at $100 then $25/day (per a Campendium review) fits the same pattern. Its disclaimer 'Farnum Park is not for primary residence' is a lease-term caveat, not evidence of transient tourist camping. 12 full-hookup sites to 55 ft, open year round, so it is a real and currently-operating RV park - it is excluded on purpose as a workforce park, not for lack of evidence.
